column9: Hyde No. 11 The Peat Cask and similar releases are heavily peated; base range otherwise mixed/unpeated. Pattern may not catch every peated release name in the full 23-product catalogue.
Peatist Series uses lightly peated malt sourced from Europe.
Solist Peaty Cask uses lightly peated malt.
Described as mildly peated, lighter than Bold.
21 Year Old The Peated Blend incorporates peated malts; described as adding "subtle smokiness", not extreme.
Peated Finish is red-wine-cask spirit finished about 18 months in peated Islay casks; rated medium since it is a cask finish rather than primary peated-malt maturation.
The Peated NAS expression; specific ppm not published so rated medium.
Peated Reserve variant exists; intensity not detailed so rated medium conservatively.
Distillery also produces "Peated English Malt" / "Peated Black Malt" spirit; ppm not published so rated medium. Exact bottling name carrying "Peated" not confirmed.
